result.topic_en: Notes on the theory of elasticity: the virtual work of internal forces expressed through the principal strains λ1, λ2, λ3, the resulting elastic energy written in terms of the displacement derivatives, and a transformation to complex coordinates p = y+zi, q = y−zi and to polar coordinates.
result.transcription:
$\lambda_1, \lambda_2, \lambda_3$ die ganzen[?] Dilatationen
$\delta P$ das Gesammtmoment der {+inneren+} [-von der-] [-...-] Kräften[?] des Körpers erhaltenen[?] Kräfte[?]
$\delta P = \int \varrho\, dV \left[ \begin{array}{l} -(a\lambda_1 + b\lambda_2 + b\lambda_3)\delta\lambda_1 \\ -(b\lambda_1 + a\lambda_2 + b\lambda_3)\delta\lambda_2 \\ -(b\lambda_1 + b\lambda_2 + a\lambda_3)\delta\lambda_3 \end{array} \right]$, wo [-...-] $a > b > 0$

[-x-], [-y-] $y$, $z$ [-...-] die rechtwinkligen Coordinaten eines unbestimmten materiellen Punktes vor der [-Biegung-] {+...+}
$x+u,\ y+v,\ z+w$ Coordinaten dieses Punktes nach der Biegung[?]

$(\lambda_1 + \lambda_2 + \lambda_3) = \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial v}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial z}$
$(\lambda_2\lambda_3 + \lambda_3\lambda_1 + \lambda_1\lambda_2) = \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\frac{\partial v}{\partial z} \cdots\right) - \frac{1}{4}\left(\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial z} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial y}\right)^2 \cdots\right)$
$4P = \int \varrho\, dV \left[ 2a(\lambda_1+\lambda_2+\lambda_3)^2 - 4(a-b)(\lambda_2\lambda_3 + \lambda_3\lambda_1 + \lambda_1\lambda_2) \right]$
$= \int \varrho\, dV \left[ (a-b)\left[\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial z} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial y}\right)^2 + \cdots\right] + 2\left[\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\right)^2 \cdots\right] + 2b\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial v}{\partial y} \cdots\right)^2 \right]$
$p = y + zi \quad \pi = v + wi$
$q = y - zi \quad \chi = v - wi$
$\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial z} = \frac{\partial \pi}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial \chi}{\partial q}$
$2\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\right)^2 + 2\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial z} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial y}\right)^2 = 4\frac{\partial \pi}{\partial q}\frac{\partial \chi}{\partial p} + \left(\frac{\partial \pi}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial \chi}{\partial q}\right)^2$
$\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial z} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial x}\right)^2 = \left(2\frac{\partial u}{\partial q} + \frac{\partial \pi}{\partial x}\right)\left(2\frac{\partial u}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial \chi}{\partial x}\right)$
$p = re^{\varphi i} \quad \pi = \varrho e^{\psi i} - p$
[-...-] $\psi = \varphi + \vartheta$[?]
$4\frac{\partial \pi}{\partial q}\frac{\partial \chi}{\partial p} = \left(\frac{\partial \varrho}{\partial r} - \frac{\varrho}{r}\frac{\partial \psi}{\partial \varphi}\right)^2 + \left(\varrho\frac{\partial \psi}{\partial r} + \frac{\partial \varrho}{r\,\partial \varphi}\right)^2$
$\frac{\partial \pi}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial \chi}{\partial q} = \cos(\varphi-\psi)\left(\frac{\partial \varrho}{\partial r} + \frac{\varrho\,\partial \psi}{r\,\partial \varphi}\right) + \sin(\varphi-\psi)\left(\frac{\varrho\,\partial \psi}{\partial r} - \frac{\partial \varrho}{r\,\partial \varphi}\right) - 2$
$\left(2\frac{\partial u}{\partial q} + \frac{\partial \pi}{\partial x}\right)e^{\varphi i} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial r} + \frac{\partial u}{r\,\partial \varphi}i + \frac{\partial \varrho}{\partial x}e^{(\psi-\varphi)i} + \frac{\varrho\,\partial \psi}{\partial x}\, i\, e^{(\psi-\varphi)i}$
$\frac{\partial \pi}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial \chi}{\partial q} = \frac{\partial (\cos(\varphi-\psi)\varrho)}{\partial r} + \frac{\partial\, \varrho \sin(\psi-\varphi)}{r\,\partial \varphi}$ [-...-] $+ \frac{\varrho}{r}\cos(\varphi-\psi) - 2 = \frac{\partial\, r\varrho\cos(\varphi-\psi)}{r\,\partial r} + \frac{\partial\, \varrho\sin(\psi-\varphi)}{r\,\partial \varphi}$

methods.what: Virtual work of internal elastic forces as a quadratic form in the principal dilatations with constants a > b > 0
methods.quote: $\delta P = \int \varrho\, dV \left[ \begin{array}{l} -(a\lambda_1 + b\lambda_2 + b\lambda_3)\delta\lambda_1 \\ -(b\lambda_1 + a\lambda_2 + b\lambda_3)\delta\lambda_2 \\ -(b\lambda_1 + b\lambda_2 + a\lambda_3)\delta\lambda_3 \end{array} \right]$, wo [-...-] $a > b > 0$

methods.what: Strain invariants (trace and second invariant) expressed through displacement derivatives
methods.quote: $(\lambda_1 + \lambda_2 + \lambda_3) = \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial v}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial z}$

methods.what: Elastic energy written in terms of the strain invariants and then in terms of displacement derivatives
Complex coordinates p = y+zi, q = y−zi and complex displacement π = v+wi, χ = v−wi used to rewrite the strain terms
methods.quote: $2\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\right)^2 + 2\left(\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial z} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial y}\right)^2 = 4\frac{\partial \pi}{\partial q}\frac{\partial \chi}{\partial p} + \left(\frac{\partial \pi}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial \chi}{\partial q}\right)^2$

methods.what: Shear terms in x expressed via the complex derivatives
methods.quote: $\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial z} + \frac{\partial w}{\partial x}\right)^2 = \left(2\frac{\partial u}{\partial q} + \frac{\partial \pi}{\partial x}\right)\left(2\frac{\partial u}{\partial p} + \frac{\partial \chi}{\partial x}\right)$

methods.what: Transformation to polar form p = r e^{φi}, π = ϱ e^{ψi} − p and resulting expressions for the strain terms
